records.literal_gloss: [The] words of Amos, who was among the sheep breeders from Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in [the] days of Uzziah king of Judah and in [the] days of Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

en.L: The words of Amos, who was among the sheep breeders from Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
en.B: The words of Amos, one of the sheep breeders of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel during the reign of Uzziah king of Judah and during the reign of Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
en.R: These are the words of Amos, a sheep farmer from the town of Tekoa. He saw these things about Israel while Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Joash was king of Israel. It was two years before the earthquake.

es.B: Palabras de Amós, uno de los pastores de Tecoa, que él vio acerca de Israel durante el reinado de Uzías, rey de Judá, y durante el reinado de Jeroboam hijo de Joás, rey de Israel, dos años antes del terremoto.

vi.L: Những lời của A-mốt, là người ở trong số những người chăn nuôi chiên tại Thê-cô-a, những điều ông đã thấy về Y-sơ-ra-ên trong đời Ô-xia vua Giu-đa và trong đời Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, hai năm trước trận động đất.
vi.B: Lời của A-mốt, một trong những người chăn nuôi chiên ở Thê-cô-a, là những điều ông đã thấy về Y-sơ-ra-ên dưới triều Ô-xia vua Giu-đa và dưới triều Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, hai năm trước trận động đất.
vi.R: Đây là những lời của A-mốt, một người nuôi chiên ở thị trấn Thê-cô-a. Ông đã thấy những điều này về Y-sơ-ra-ên khi Ô-xia làm vua Giu-đa và Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Giô-ách làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Đó là hai năm trước trận động đất.

ko.L: 드고아의 양 치는 사람들 가운데 하나였던 아모스의 말. 그가 유다 왕 웃시야의 시대와 요아스의 아들 이스라엘 왕 여로보암의 시대, 곧 지진이 일어나기 2년 전에 이스라엘에 관하여 본 것이다.
ko.B: 드고아의 양 치는 사람 아모스의 말이다. 그는 웃시야가 유다를 다스리고 요아스의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘을 다스리던 때, 지진이 일어나기 2년 전에 이스라엘에 관한 이 일들을 보았다.
ko.R: 이것은 드고아 마을에서 양을 치던 아모스의 말이다. 그는 웃시야가 유다의 왕이었고 요아스의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘의 왕이었을 때에 이스라엘에 관한 이 일들을 보았다. 그때는 지진이 일어나기 2년 전이었다.

decisions.choice: Amos was one of the sheep breeders of Tekoa, a town in the hill country of Judah
decisions.reason: The word for Amos's work is not the usual word for a shepherd. It is used elsewhere only of Mesha king of Moab, who paid Israel a tribute of a hundred thousand lambs (2 Kings 3:4), so it may mean an owner or breeder of flocks rather than a hired hand. In 7:14-15 Amos also calls himself a herdsman and a tender of sycamore figs, whom the LORD took from following the flock. Tekoa was a town about ten miles south of Jerusalem, on the edge of the wilderness of Judah (2 Samuel 14:2; 2 Chronicles 11:6). So Amos was a man of Judah sent to speak to the northern kingdom of Israel (7:12-13).

decisions.choice: the words of Amos, which he saw: the prophet's words, given to him as things seen
decisions.reason: The heading calls the book Amos's words and says that he "saw" them. The verb is the one used for a prophet's visions (Isaiah 1:1; 2:1; Micah 1:1). The words are what the LORD showed him, and chapters 7-9 tell five of the visions. "Concerning Israel" names the northern kingdom, the main subject of the book.

decisions.choice: Uzziah of Judah and Jeroboam son of Joash of Israel: Amos spoke in the middle of the eighth century BC
decisions.reason: Uzziah reigned in Judah from about 792 to 740 BC, and Jeroboam son of Joash, Jeroboam II, in Israel from about 793 to 753 BC (2 Kings 14:23-29; 15:1-7). Jeroboam won back much of Israel's old territory, and his reign was a time of wealth and security for the northern kingdom, which is the background of Amos's charges against the rich (3:15; 4:1; 6:4-6). Hosea's heading names the same kings (Hosea 1:1). Jeroboam son of Joash is not Jeroboam son of Nebat, Israel's first king.

decisions.choice: two years before the earthquake: a well-remembered earthquake, which dates Amos's words
decisions.reason: The heading dates Amos's prophecy by an event its first readers knew. The earthquake was remembered for centuries: Zechariah 14:5 speaks of people fleeing "from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah". Its exact date is not known; it is usually placed about 760 BC, and remains of heavy earthquake damage from about that time have been found at sites in Israel such as Hazor. Amos's own words speak of the land shaking (8:8; 9:1), and the heading may record the earthquake as a sign that his words had come true. Either way, it places his preaching within a short period, perhaps a single year.

decisions.choice: The words of Amos (L, B); sheep breeders (L, B), sheep farmer (R); in the days of (L), during the reign of (B), while ... was king (R)
decisions.reason: The heading begins like Jeremiah 1:1 ("The words of Jeremiah") and follows the wording set for the dated headings of the prophets: "in the days of X" at Literal, "during the reign of X" at Balanced, "while X was king" at Readable. "Sheep breeders" keeps the difference from the ordinary word for a shepherd (m1). Readable splits the long heading into three sentences and adds "the town of".

decisions.choice: "Palabras de Amós" (L, B); "en los días de" (L), "durante el reinado de" (B), "cuando ... era rey" (R)
decisions.reason: The heading follows the Spanish headings of the Twelve (Jeremiah 1:1-2) at each level; Amos's book opens with "words", not "the word of the LORD".

decisions.choice: "uno de los pastores de Tecoa" (L, B); "un criador de ovejas" (R)
decisions.reason: Noqed is a breeder of sheep, as Mesha in 2 Kings 3:4 ("criador de ovejas"); the terms note keeps "pastores de Tecoa" at L and B, and R says what the work was. Amós, Tecoa, Uzías and Jeroboam hijo de Joás are the published forms.

decisions.choice: "Amos, de Teqoa"; "Ozias"; "Jéroboam fils de Joas", for the whole book
decisions.reason: The prophet and the kings keep the forms of the published French Kings and Chronicles, as the term sheet for the Twelve lists them; one form holds in every book of the Twelve.

decisions.choice: Amos's oracles are speech: present, future and passé composé at every level; the heading and the narratives (Amos's visions in 7:1-9, 8:1-3 and 9:1, and 7:10-17) take the passé simple at L and B and the passé composé at R
decisions.reason: As in the other prophets in French: God's words and the prophet's poetry are spoken; the book's heading and the accounts of what Amos saw and what happened at Bethel are written narrative.

decisions.choice: "Maneno ya Amosi ... aliyoyaona"; "katika siku za" (L), "wakati wa utawala wa" (B), "wakati ... alipokuwa mfalme" (R)
decisions.reason: The book heading follows the Swahili heading formula of the prophets (Jeremiah 1:1-2, Hosea 1:1), with the Hebrew's "words" in place of "word of the LORD". Names as published: Amosi, Tekoa, Uzia, Yeroboamu mwana wa Yoashi.

decisions.choice: "A-mốt người Thê-cô-a"
alternatives: a separate spelling for the prophet
decisions.reason: The Protestant tradition spells both the prophet Amos and Isaiah's father Amoz "A-mốt" (2 Kings 19:20); they are two different men with different Hebrew names. "Thê-cô-a" is the published form (1 Chronicles 11:28).

decisions.choice: "những người chăn nuôi chiên" (L, B); "người nuôi chiên" (R)
decisions.reason: Noqdim are sheep breeders (meaning decision); the plain compound avoids "mục tử", which reads as the church word for a pastor.

decisions.choice: "드고아의 양 치는 사람 아모스"; "아모스의 말 … 본 것" (L); the dated heading "…의 시대에" (L), "…가 다스리던 때" (B), "…가 왕이었을 때" (R)
decisions.reason: The names and the heading formula of the term sheet; Literal keeps "the words … which he saw", the prophet's words given as things seen. Years are in figures ("2년").

source.text: וַיֹּאמַ֓ר׀יְהוָה֙ מִצִיּ֣וֹןיִשְׁאָ֔ג וּמִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֑וֹ וְאָֽבְלוּ֙ נְא֣וֹת הָרֹעִ֔ים וְיָבֵ֖שׁ רֹ֥אשׁ הַכַּרְמֶֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Yahweh from Zion roars, and from Jerusalem gives his voice; and dry up [the] pastures of the shepherds, and withers [the] top of the Carmel.

en.L: And he said: \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} roars from Zion, \q and from Jerusalem {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} utters {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice; \q the pastures of the shepherds dry up, \q and the top of Carmel withers.
en.B: He said: \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} roars from Zion \q and thunders from Jerusalem; \q the shepherds' pastures dry up, \q and the summit of Carmel withers.
en.R: Amos said: \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} roars like a lion from Zion. \q His voice thunders from Jerusalem. \q The pastures where shepherds feed their flocks dry up, \q and the grass on top of Mount Carmel withers.

es.L: Y dijo: \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ruge desde Sion, \q y desde Jerusalén da {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz; \q se secan los pastos de los pastores, \q y se marchita la cumbre del Carmelo.
es.B: Dijo: \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ruge desde Sion \q y truena desde Jerusalén; \q se secan los pastizales de los pastores, \q y se marchita la cumbre del Carmelo.
es.R: Amós dijo: \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ruge como un león desde Sion. \q Su voz truena desde Jerusalén. \q Se secan los pastos donde los pastores alimentan sus rebaños, \q y se marchita la hierba en la cumbre del monte Carmelo.

fr.L: Et il dit : \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rugit de Sion, \q et de Jérusalem {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait entendre {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix ; \q les pâturages des bergers se dessèchent, \q et le sommet du Carmel se flétrit.
fr.B: Il dit : \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rugit de Sion \q et tonne de Jérusalem ; \q les pâturages des bergers se dessèchent, \q et le sommet du Carmel se flétrit.
fr.R: Amos a dit : \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rugit comme un lion depuis Sion. \q Sa voix tonne depuis Jérusalem. \q Les pâturages où les bergers font paître leurs troupeaux se dessèchent, \q et l’herbe se flétrit au sommet du mont Carmel.

sw.L: Naye akasema: \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ananguruma kutoka Sayuni, \q na kutoka Yerusalemu anatoa sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q malisho ya wachungaji yanakauka, \q na kilele cha Karmeli kinanyauka.
sw.B: Akasema: \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ananguruma kutoka Sayuni \q na kuvuma kama radi kutoka Yerusalemu; \q malisho ya wachungaji yanakauka, \q na kilele cha Karmeli kinanyauka.
sw.R: Amosi alisema: \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ananguruma kama simba kutoka Sayuni. \q Sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} inavuma kama radi kutoka Yerusalemu. \q Malisho ambako wachungaji hulisha makundi yao yanakauka, \q na majani juu ya mlima Karmeli yananyauka.

vi.L: Và ông nói: \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gầm thét từ Si-ôn, \q và từ Giê-ru-sa-lem {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cất tiếng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q các đồng cỏ của những người chăn khô héo, \q và đỉnh núi Cạt-mên tàn úa.
vi.B: Ông nói: \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gầm thét từ Si-ôn \q và cất tiếng như sấm từ Giê-ru-sa-lem; \q các đồng cỏ của người chăn khô héo, \q và đỉnh Cạt-mên tàn úa.
vi.R: A-mốt nói: \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gầm thét như sư tử từ Si-ôn. \q Tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vang như sấm từ Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Những đồng cỏ nơi người chăn cho bầy chiên ăn đều khô héo, \q và cỏ trên đỉnh núi Cạt-mên tàn úa.

ko.L: 그가 말했다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온에서 부르짖으시고, \q 예루살렘에서 그분의 목소리를 내시니, \q 목자들의 풀밭이 마르고, \q 갈멜의 꼭대기가 시든다.
ko.B: 그가 말했다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온에서 포효하시고 \q 예루살렘에서 우렛소리를 내시니, \q 목자들의 풀밭이 마르고 \q 갈멜 산꼭대기가 시든다.
ko.R: 아모스가 말했다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온에서 사자처럼 부르짖으신다. \q 그분의 목소리가 예루살렘에서 천둥처럼 울린다. \q 목자들이 양 떼를 먹이는 풀밭이 마르고, \q 갈멜산 꼭대기의 풀이 시든다.

decisions.choice: and he said: Amos speaks, and the verse stands as a motto over the whole book
decisions.reason: The speaker is Amos, named in verse 1. Before the oracles begin he announces their theme: the LORD speaks from Zion, from the temple in Jerusalem, and not from the shrines of the northern kingdom at Bethel and Gilgal that Amos attacks (3:14; 4:4; 5:5). The poem has no quotation marks because it is the prophet's own poetry.

decisions.choice: the LORD roars from Zion and utters his voice from Jerusalem: the same two lines as Joel 4:16
decisions.reason: Joel 4:16 has these two lines word for word and goes on, "and the heavens and the earth shake". In Joel the roar announces the LORD's judgment on the nations and his protection of his people; in Amos it begins a series of judgments that ends on Israel itself (2:6). Jeremiah 25:30 uses the same picture: "The LORD will roar from on high". The roar is a lion's roar, and the image returns in 3:4 and 3:8.

decisions.choice: utters his voice: thunders
decisions.reason: "To give one's voice" is used of thunder, the LORD's voice in the storm (Psalm 18:14; 46:7; compare Psalm 29:3-9). Here it stands beside the lion's roar, so both pictures, a lion and a thunderstorm, may be heard: a sound that terrifies and comes before destruction.

decisions.choice: dry up: the pastures wither, as in a drought
decisions.reason: The verb usually means "mourn". There is also a word of the same form that means "dry up", and the parallel line ("withers") favors that sense here (compare Jeremiah 12:4; 23:10). The land "mourning" is a picture the prophets also use (Hosea 4:3; Joel 1:10), and a hearer may catch both senses.

decisions.choice: the pastures of the shepherds ... the top of Carmel: the whole land, from the grazing land to its richest heights
decisions.reason: Carmel is the mountain ridge on the coast of northern Israel, famous for its green woods and pasture (Isaiah 33:9; 35:2). When the LORD's roar withers the shepherds' grazing land, Amos's own world, and even the top of Carmel, nothing in the land is spared.

decisions.choice: He said (B), Amos said (R); thunders (B, R); roars like a lion (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker, who is Amos (m1). Balanced and Readable say "thunders" for "gives his voice" (m3). Readable adds "like a lion" because the verb is the one used of a lion's roar (3:4, 8), and the image is lost on readers who hear only a loud noise. It also says "the grass on top of" Mount Carmel, since it is the growth there that withers.

decisions.choice: the wording of Joel 4:16
decisions.reason: The first two lines are Joel 4:16, and the Spanish keeps one wording for both passages at each level.

decisions.choice: "rugit de Sion ... de Jérusalem il fait entendre sa voix" (L); "rugit de Sion et tonne de Jérusalem" (B); "rugit comme un lion depuis Sion. Sa voix tonne depuis Jérusalem" (R)
decisions.reason: The same two lines open Joel 4:16, and French words them the same at each level so the reader hears the echo.

decisions.choice: "ananguruma kutoka Sayuni ... anatoa sauti yake" (L); "kuvuma kama radi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew lines as Joel 4:16, worded the same at each level.

decisions.choice: the wording of Joel 4:16 at each level for the two shared lines
decisions.reason: The LORD's roar from Zion repeats Joel 4:16 word for word in the Hebrew, so each level keeps the Vietnamese of that verse; Amos's own lines follow.

decisions.choice: no quotation marks after "Ông nói:"
decisions.reason: Amos's words are the prophet's poetry, which takes no quotation marks; the colon introduces them, as Vietnamese introduces speech.

decisions.choice: The first two lines read as Joel 4:16 at each level ("부르짖으시고 … 목소리를 내시니" L; "포효하시고 … 우렛소리를 내시니" B; "사자처럼 부르짖으신다 … 천둥처럼 울린다" R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats Joel 4:16, and lines a book or the Twelve repeat keep one wording.

source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י דַמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־דּוּשָׁ֛ם בַּחֲרֻצ֥וֹת הַבַּרְזֶ֖ל אֶת־הַגִּלְעָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: For three transgressions of Damascus and for four, not I will turn it back, because they threshed with the threshing sledges of iron the Gilead.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q For three transgressions of Damascus, \q and for four, I will not turn it back, \q because they threshed Gilead with threshing sledges of iron.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q For three crimes of Damascus, \q even for four, I will not hold back the punishment, \q because they threshed Gilead with iron threshing sledges.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q The people of Damascus have sinned again and again, \q so I will not hold back their punishment. \q They crushed the people of Gilead like grain under iron threshing sledges.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Por tres transgresiones de Damasco, \q y por cuatro, no lo haré volver atrás, \q porque trillaron a Galaad con trillos de hierro.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q Por tres delitos de Damasco, \q y aun por cuatro, no retendré el castigo, \q porque trillaron a Galaad con trillos de hierro.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q La gente de Damasco ha pecado una y otra vez, \q así que no retendré su castigo. \q Aplastaron a la gente de Galaad como se trilla el grano con trillos de hierro.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Pour trois transgressions de Damas, \q et pour quatre, je ne le retirerai pas, \q parce qu’ils ont foulé Galaad avec des traîneaux à battre en fer.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Pour trois crimes de Damas, \q et même pour quatre, je ne retiendrai pas le châtiment, \q parce qu’ils ont broyé Galaad avec des traîneaux à battre en fer.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Les gens de Damas ont péché encore et encore, \q alors je ne retiendrai pas leur punition. \q Ils ont écrasé les habitants de Galaad comme du grain sous des traîneaux de fer.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Kwa maasi matatu ya Dameski, \q naam, kwa manne, sitalirudisha nyuma, \q kwa sababu waliipura Gileadi kwa vyombo vya kupuria vya chuma.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Kwa makosa matatu ya Dameski, \q hata kwa manne, sitaizuia adhabu, \q kwa sababu waliipura Gileadi kwa vyombo vya chuma vya kupuria.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Watu wa Dameski wamefanya dhambi tena na tena, \q kwa hiyo sitaizuia adhabu yao. \q Waliwaponda watu wa Gileadi kama nafaka chini ya vyombo vya chuma vya kupuria.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Vì ba tội vi phạm của Đa-mách, \q và vì bốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại điều ấy, \q vì chúng đã dùng bàn đập lúa bằng sắt mà đập Ga-la-át.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Vì ba tội ác của Đa-mách, \q phải, vì bốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại hình phạt, \q vì chúng đã đập Ga-la-át bằng những bàn đập lúa bằng sắt.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Dân Đa-mách đã phạm tội hết lần này đến lần khác, \q nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại hình phạt dành cho chúng. \q Chúng đã nghiền nát dân Ga-la-át như nghiền lúa dưới bàn đập lúa bằng sắt.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 다메섹의 세 가지 반역과 \q 네 가지 [반역] 때문에 내가 그것을 되돌리지 않겠다. \q 그들이 쇠 타작 썰매로 길르앗을 타작했기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 다메섹이 지은 범죄가 셋, \q 아니 넷이나 되니 내가 그 벌을 거두지 않겠다. \q 그들이 쇠 타작 썰매로 길르앗을 짓밟았기 때문이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 다메섹 백성이 죄를 짓고 또 지었으니 \q 나는 그들에게 내릴 벌을 거두지 않겠다. \q 그들은 곡식을 떨듯 쇠 타작 썰매로 길르앗 사람들을 짓이겼다.

decisions.choice: for three transgressions ... and for four: crimes piled up past counting, until the measure is full
decisions.reason: Hebrew poetry often names a number and then the next one up (Proverbs 30:15-31; Job 5:19; Micah 5:4). The pattern says "many, and then one more": the crimes have gone on long enough, and the last one is too many. It does not mean that exactly three or four are counted. Each oracle against the nations names one crime as the example; the oracle against Israel names several (2:6-8). The same refrain opens all eight oracles (1:3, 6, 9, 11, 13; 2:1, 4, 6). Its wording is kept the same in each, and the notes here apply to all of them.

decisions.choice: I will not turn it back: "it" is most likely the punishment that the LORD has decided on
alternatives: I will not call back my word
I will not turn back my anger
I will not bring him back (restore the nation)
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn back, to call back, or to bring back, and "it" has nothing in the sentence for it to refer to. Most readers take it as the punishment about to be announced, or the decree to punish: the LORD will not call back what he has decided (compare Numbers 23:20; Isaiah 45:23; 55:11). Others take "it" as the LORD's word or roar of 1:2, or his anger. A few read the verb as "I will not bring him back", meaning that the LORD will not restore the nation. The text does not say, and the refrain may leave "it" unnamed on purpose, to be filled by the fire of the next verse. On every reading the sense is that the judgment is fixed.

decisions.choice: transgressions: deliberate breaches of what is owed, rebellion against an authority
decisions.reason: The word is used of a people's revolt against its overlord (1 Kings 12:19; 2 Kings 8:20, 22) and of a wrong done to a neighbor (Genesis 31:36). The nations of 1:3-2:3 have no covenant with the LORD, but he holds them to account for acts of cruelty against other peoples. For Judah and Israel (2:4, 6) the same word names their breaking of the covenant itself.

decisions.choice: threshing sledges of iron: heavy boards with iron teeth, dragged over grain to break it; here the brutal crushing of Gilead
decisions.reason: A threshing sledge was a heavy wooden board studded underneath with sharp stones or iron, drawn over the cut grain to break the stalks (Isaiah 28:27; 41:15). Gilead was Israel's land east of the Jordan. In the days of Hazael (verse 4) Aram took Gilead and crushed Israel's army, making it "like the dust at threshing" (2 Kings 10:32-33; 13:3-7). Whether the sledges were used on captives or the phrase pictures a ruthless war, the crime is cruelty to a conquered people.

decisions.choice: the refrain: For three transgressions of X, and for four, I will not turn it back (L); For three crimes of X, even for four, I will not hold back the punishment (B); The people of X have sinned again and again, so I will not hold back their punishment (R)
decisions.reason: This is the wording set for Amos, used unchanged in all eight oracles. Literal keeps the number pattern and the unnamed "it". Balanced says "crimes", the sense of the word in these oracles, and names "the punishment" for the unclear "it" (m2). Readable says what the number pattern means (m1) and names the punishment. "Thus says the LORD" follows the formula set for the prophets: "Thus says the LORD:" (L), "The LORD says this:" (B), "This is what the LORD says:" (R).

decisions.choice: crushed the people of Gilead like grain
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture: the people of Gilead were crushed as grain is crushed under a threshing sledge.

decisions.choice: "Por tres transgresiones de X, y por cuatro, no lo haré volver atrás" (L); "Por tres delitos de X, y aun por cuatro, no retendré el castigo" (B); "La gente de X ha pecado una y otra vez, así que no retendré su castigo" (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain keeps one wording at each level in all eight oracles (1:3-2:6), as the terms note sets; Balanced and Readable avoid the familiar "no revocaré su castigo". In L the "lo" stays as open as the Hebrew "it"; B and R name the punishment, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "trillos de hierro"
decisions.reason: Threshing sledges are "trillos", as 1 Chronicles 21:23 in Spanish.

decisions.choice: the refrain, in all eight oracles: "Pour trois transgressions de X, et pour quatre, je ne le retirerai pas" (L); "Pour trois crimes de X, et même pour quatre, je ne retiendrai pas le châtiment" (B); "Les gens de X ont péché encore et encore, alors je ne retiendrai pas leur punition" (R)
alternatives: "je ne reviendrai pas sur ma décision" (B)
decisions.reason: One wording at each level for every oracle, as in English; transgression is "transgression" (L), "crime" (B), "péché" (R), as the term sheet sets for the Twelve. Literal's "le" keeps the Hebrew's unnamed "it", most likely the punishment (the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "Ainsi parle le SEIGNEUR :" (L); "Le SEIGNEUR dit ceci :" (B); "Voici ce que dit le SEIGNEUR :" (R); "dit le SEIGNEUR" at every level for the closing "says the LORD"
alternatives: "déclare le SEIGNEUR" for the closing formula
decisions.reason: The formulas of the French prophets. The closing formula in these oracles is the verb "say", not the declaration formula that French renders "déclare", so it is "dit" at every level.

decisions.choice: "BWANA asema hivi:" (L); "Hivi ndivyo BWANA asemavyo:" (B); "Hili ndilo BWANA analosema:" (R)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula as in Kings, Isaiah and Jeremiah; recorded once for Amos and Obadiah.

decisions.choice: "Kwa maasi matatu ya X, naam, kwa manne, sitalirudisha nyuma" (L); "Kwa makosa matatu ya X, hata kwa manne, sitaizuia adhabu" (B); "Watu wa X wamefanya dhambi tena na tena, kwa hiyo sitaizuia adhabu yao" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording at each level in all eight oracles. Pesha' is "maasi" / "makosa" / "dhambi", as Psalm 51:3. At Literal the vague Hebrew "it" is the class 5 object marker "-li-", which points to no noun in particular; that is a guess at how Swahili keeps the vagueness.

decisions.choice: "Vì ba tội vi phạm của X, và vì bốn, Ta sẽ không rút lại điều ấy" (L); "Vì ba tội ác của X, phải, vì bốn, Ta sẽ không rút lại hình phạt" (B); "Dân X đã phạm tội hết lần này đến lần khác, nên Ta sẽ không rút lại hình phạt dành cho chúng" (R)
alternatives: "Bởi cớ tội ác ... ta không xây bỏ án phạt" (1926)
decisions.reason: The refrain of the terms sheet, worded the same in all eight oracles of chapters 1-2. Literal keeps the Hebrew's vague "it" as "điều ấy" (the meaning decision says it is most likely the punishment); Balanced says "hình phạt" without brackets.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán thế này:" (L); "CHÚA phán như vầy:" (B); "Đây là lời CHÚA phán:" (R)
decisions.reason: "Thus says the LORD" keeps the formula settled for Isaiah and Jeremiah. Amos's closing "says the LORD" ('amar YHWH, not ne'um) is "CHÚA phán" at every level, keeping "phán vậy" for "declares".

decisions.choice: The refrain of 1:3–2:6, one wording per level in all eight oracles: "X의 세 가지 반역과 네 가지 [반역] 때문에 내가 그것을 되돌리지 않겠다" (L); "X가 지은 범죄가 셋, 아니 넷이나 되니 내가 그 벌을 거두지 않겠다" (B); "X 백성이 죄를 짓고 또 지었으니 나는 그들에게 내릴 벌을 거두지 않겠다" (R). *Pesha'* is "반역" (L), "범죄" (B), "죄" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording. Literal keeps the unclear "it" ("그것"), which most read as the punishment, as the English does; Balanced and Readable say the punishment.

decisions.choice: "Thus says the LORD": "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다." (L); "…이렇게 말씀하신다." (B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다." (R), ending in a period
decisions.reason: The formula as Isaiah and Jeremiah settled it, keeping 께서 even before God's own words, as the published Kings does.

source.text: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּבֵ֣ית חֲזָאֵ֑ל וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בֶּן־הֲדָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will send fire on [the] house of Hazael, and it will consume [the] fortresses of Ben-hadad.

en.L: So I will send fire on the house of Hazael, \q and it will consume the fortresses of Ben-hadad.
en.B: So I will send fire on the house of Hazael, \q and it will devour the fortresses of Ben-hadad.
en.R: So I will send fire on the royal house of Hazael, \q and it will burn up the fortresses of Ben-hadad.

es.L: Por eso enviaré fuego sobre la casa de Hazael, \q y consumirá las fortalezas de Ben-adad.
es.B: Por eso enviaré fuego sobre la casa de Hazael, \q y devorará las fortalezas de Ben-adad.
es.R: Por eso enviaré fuego sobre la familia real de Hazael, \q y quemará las fortalezas de Ben-adad.

fr.L: Alors j’enverrai le feu sur la maison de Hazaël, \q et il consumera les forteresses de Ben-Hadad.
fr.B: Alors j’enverrai le feu sur la maison de Hazaël, \q et il dévorera les forteresses de Ben-Hadad.
fr.R: Alors j’enverrai le feu sur la famille royale de Hazaël, \q et il brûlera les forteresses de Ben-Hadad.

sw.L: Basi nitatuma moto juu ya nyumba ya Hazaeli, \q nao utaziteketeza ngome za Ben-hadadi.
sw.B: Basi nitatuma moto juu ya nyumba ya Hazaeli, \q nao utazila ngome za Ben-hadadi.
sw.R: Basi nitatuma moto juu ya jamaa ya kifalme ya Hazaeli, \q nao utaziunguza ngome za Ben-hadadi.

vi.L: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai lửa xuống trên nhà Ha-xa-ên, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu nuốt các đồn lũy của Bên-Ha-đát.
vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai lửa xuống trên nhà Ha-xa-ên, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu rụi các đồn lũy của Bên-Ha-đát.
vi.R: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai lửa xuống trên hoàng tộc Ha-xa-ên, \q và lửa sẽ đốt cháy các đồn lũy của Bên-Ha-đát.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 하사엘의 집에 불을 보내겠다. \q 그 불이 벤하닷의 요새들을 사를 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 하사엘의 집에 불을 보내겠다. \q 그 불이 벤하닷의 요새들을 삼킬 것이다.
ko.R: 그러므로 나는 하사엘 왕의 집안에 불을 보내겠다. \q 그 불이 벤하닷의 요새들을 태워 버릴 것이다.

decisions.choice: I will send fire ... and it will consume the fortresses: the punishment repeated in every oracle
decisions.reason: The same sentence, with only the names changed, follows the crimes of each nation (1:4, 7, 10, 12, 14; 2:2, 5). The fire is the fire of war, when a conquering army burns a captured city, but the LORD says that he sends it.

decisions.choice: fortresses: the strong, fortified buildings of a city, the palaces of its rulers and its rich
decisions.reason: The word means a strong, high building, a citadel or fortified palace. It is where the powerful lived and stored their wealth, and Amos uses it again of the great houses of Samaria, full of goods taken by violence (3:9-11; 6:8).

decisions.choice: the house of Hazael ... Ben-hadad: the kings of Damascus who made war on Israel
decisions.reason: Hazael seized the throne of Aram in Damascus about 842 BC (2 Kings 8:7-15) and made war on Israel for many years; his son Ben-hadad carried it on (2 Kings 13:3, 22-25). "The house of Hazael" is his royal family and its palace. Ben-hadad was also the name of earlier kings of Damascus (1 Kings 15:18; 20:1), so the two names stand for the whole royal line.

decisions.choice: So I will send fire; consume (L), devour (B), burn up (R); the royal house (R)
decisions.reason: "So" shows that the punishment follows from the crime. Each level keeps one wording for this sentence in all eight oracles. Readable says "royal house" to make clear that "house" means the king's family and palace.

decisions.choice: "enviaré fuego ... consumirá" (L), "devorará" (B), "quemará" (R) las fortalezas
decisions.reason: The punishment repeated in every oracle keeps one wording at each level; "fortalezas" for armenot as the English "fortresses".

decisions.choice: "Alors j'enverrai le feu sur ..."; "consumera" (L), "dévorera" (B), "brûlera" (R) "les forteresses", in every oracle
decisions.reason: The punishment repeated in every oracle keeps one wording at each level; "forteresses" says the fortified buildings of the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: "nitatuma moto"; "utaziteketeza" (L), "utazila" (B), "utaziunguza" (R) "ngome"
decisions.reason: The punishment line of every oracle keeps one wording at each level, as in English.

decisions.choice: "lửa sẽ thiêu nuốt" (L); "thiêu rụi" (B); "đốt cháy" (R) "các đồn lũy", in every oracle
decisions.reason: The punishment line repeats in each oracle with one wording per level; "đồn lũy" is the word of the same line in Jeremiah 49:27 and 17:27.

decisions.choice: "사르다" (L), "삼키다" (B), "태워 버리다" (R); "요새들" for the fortresses
decisions.reason: One wording per level for the fire that ends every oracle, as the English keeps consume / devour / burn up.

source.text: וְשָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ בְּרִ֣יחַ דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ מִבִּקְעַת־אָ֔וֶן וְתוֹמֵ֥ךְ שֵׁ֖בֶט מִבֵּ֣ית עֶ֑דֶן וְגָל֧וּ עַם־אֲרָ֛ם קִ֖ירָה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I will break [the] bar of Damascus, and I will cut off [the] one sitting from [the] Valley of Aven, and [the] one holding [the] scepter from Beth-eden; and [the] people of Aram will go into exile to Kir, says Yahweh.

en.L: And I will break the bar of Damascus, \q and I will cut off the one who sits from the Valley of Aven, \q and the one who holds the scepter from Beth-eden; \q and the people of Aram will go into exile to Kir, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will break the bar of the gate of Damascus \q and cut off the ruler from the Valley of Aven \q and the one who holds the scepter from Beth-eden. \q The people of Aram will go into exile to Kir, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will break the bars of the gates of Damascus. \q I will remove the king who rules in the Valley of Aven \q and the one who holds the scepter in Beth-eden. \q The people of Aram will be taken away as captives to Kir, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y romperé el cerrojo de Damasco, \q y cortaré al que se sienta [en el trono] en el valle de Avén, \q y al que empuña el cetro en Bet-edén; \q y el pueblo de Aram irá cautivo a Quir, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Romperé el cerrojo de la puerta de Damasco \q y eliminaré al gobernante del valle de Avén \q y al que empuña el cetro en Bet-edén. \q El pueblo de Aram irá al destierro a Quir, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Romperé las trancas de las puertas de Damasco. \q Quitaré al rey que gobierna en el valle de Avén \q y al que tiene el cetro en Bet-edén. \q La gente de Aram será llevada prisionera a Quir, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et je briserai le verrou de Damas, \q et je retrancherai de la vallée d’Aven celui qui siège, \q et de Beth-Éden celui qui tient le sceptre ; \q et le peuple d’Aram ira en exil à Qir, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je briserai la barre qui ferme la porte de Damas, \q je retrancherai de la vallée d’Aven celui qui règne, \q et de Beth-Éden celui qui tient le sceptre. \q Le peuple d’Aram ira en exil à Qir, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je briserai les barres des portes de Damas. \q Je ferai disparaître le roi qui règne dans la vallée d’Aven, \q et celui qui tient le sceptre à Beth-Éden. \q Le peuple d’Aram sera emmené en captivité à Qir, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitalivunja komeo la Dameski, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamkatilia mbali yule aketiye kutoka Bonde la Aveni, \q na yule ashikaye fimbo ya enzi kutoka Beth-edeni; \q na watu wa Aramu watakwenda uhamishoni mpaka Kiri, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitalivunja komeo la lango la Dameski \q na kumkatilia mbali mtawala kutoka Bonde la Aveni \q na yule ashikaye fimbo ya enzi kutoka Beth-edeni. \q Waaramu watakwenda uhamishoni mpaka Kiri, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitayavunja makomeo ya malango ya Dameski. \q Nitamwondoa mfalme anayetawala katika Bonde la Aveni \q na yule ashikaye fimbo ya enzi katika Beth-edeni. \q Waaramu watachukuliwa mateka mpaka Kiri, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bẻ gãy then cửa của Đa-mách, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ diệt trừ kẻ ngồi [trên ngai] khỏi thung lũng A-ven, \q và kẻ cầm quyền trượng khỏi Bết-Ê-đen; \q và dân A-ram sẽ bị lưu đày đến Ki-rơ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.B: Ta sẽ bẻ gãy then cổng thành Đa-mách, \q diệt trừ kẻ cai trị ở thung lũng A-ven \q và kẻ cầm quyền trượng ở Bết-Ê-đen. \q Dân A-ram sẽ bị lưu đày đến Ki-rơ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.R: Ta sẽ bẻ gãy then cài các cổng thành Đa-mách. \q Ta sẽ loại bỏ vua cai trị ở thung lũng A-ven \q và kẻ cầm quyền trượng ở Bết-Ê-đen. \q Dân A-ram sẽ bị bắt đi làm phu tù đến Ki-rơ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 내가 다메섹의 빗장을 꺾고, \q 아웬 골짜기에서 앉은 자를 끊어 버리고, \q 벧에덴에서 홀을 잡은 자를 [끊어 버리겠다]. \q 그리고 아람 백성이 기르로 사로잡혀 갈 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.B: 내가 다메섹 성문의 빗장을 꺾고, \q 아웬 골짜기에서 통치자를 없애고, \q 벧에덴에서 홀을 잡은 자를 없애겠다. \q 아람 백성은 기르로 사로잡혀 갈 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 나는 다메섹 성문의 빗장들을 부수겠다. \q 아웬 골짜기를 다스리는 왕을 없애고, \q 벧에덴에서 홀을 잡은 자도 없애겠다. \q 아람 백성은 포로가 되어 기르로 끌려갈 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: the bar of Damascus: the beam that locked the city gate
decisions.reason: City gates were closed with a heavy bar of wood or metal (Judges 16:3; 1 Kings 4:13). When the bar is broken, the city lies open to the enemy.

decisions.choice: the one who sits: the ruler, who sits on the throne
decisions.reason: The word can mean an inhabitant or the one who sits on a throne (Psalm 2:4; Isaiah 10:13). Here it is parallel to "the one who holds the scepter", so the king or ruler is most likely meant, as again in 1:8. Some take it as "the inhabitants" of the valley.

decisions.choice: the Valley of Aven and Beth-eden: places in the kingdom of Damascus, named with a play on words
decisions.reason: "Aven" means wickedness, as in Beth-aven, Hosea's name for Bethel (Hosea 4:15). The Valley of Aven is probably the broad valley between the Lebanon ranges, north of Damascus, renamed "valley of wickedness". Beth-eden means "house of delight"; it is often taken to be Bit-Adini, an Aramean state on the Euphrates, or a royal estate near Damascus. Neither place is certain.

decisions.choice: into exile to Kir: back to the land the Arameans came from
decisions.reason: In 9:7 the LORD says that he brought the Arameans from Kir, as he brought Israel from Egypt. Their exile to Kir undoes their history. 2 Kings 16:9 tells how Tiglath-pileser of Assyria took Damascus about 732 BC and carried its people away to Kir.

decisions.choice: the one who sits (L), the ruler (B), the king who rules (R); bar of the gate (B, R); says the LORD (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the open phrase "the one who sits"; Balanced and Readable say "ruler" or "king", the sense chosen in m2. They add "gate" so that "bar" is understood. The closing formula here is the plain verb "says", which every level renders "says the LORD"; it is kept apart from "declares the LORD", the other formula of the prophets.

decisions.choice: "dice el SEÑOR" at every level
decisions.reason: Amos's closing "amar YHWH" is "says", not the oracle formula ne'um ("declara / afirma / dice"), so Spanish keeps "dice" at every level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "el valle de Avén", "Bet-edén", "Quir"
decisions.reason: Kir as 2 Kings 16:9 in Spanish; the other names in the form of Spanish names with Avén and Bet-.

decisions.choice: "says the LORD" closing an oracle (*'amar YHWH*) is "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" at every level, as its own sentence; God names himself without -시-
decisions.reason: The closing formula in God's own mouth, as Isaiah has it (1:11). Literal's "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다" is kept for *ne'um*.

source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י עַזָּ֔ה וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־הַגְלוֹתָ֛ם גָּל֥וּת שְׁלֵמָ֖ה לְהַסְגִּ֥יר לֶאֱדֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: For three transgressions of Gaza and for four, not I will turn it back, because they carried into exile a complete exile, to deliver [them] up to Edom.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q For three transgressions of Gaza, \q and for four, I will not turn it back, \q because they carried into exile a whole community, to hand [them] over to Edom.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q For three crimes of Gaza, \q even for four, I will not hold back the punishment, \q because they carried off whole communities into exile and handed them over to Edom.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q The people of Gaza have sinned again and again, \q so I will not hold back their punishment. \q They captured whole communities and handed them over to Edom as slaves.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Por tres transgresiones de Gaza, \q y por cuatro, no lo haré volver atrás, \q porque llevaron cautiva a toda una población para entregar[la] a Edom.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q Por tres delitos de Gaza, \q y aun por cuatro, no retendré el castigo, \q porque llevaron al destierro a poblaciones enteras y las entregaron a Edom.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q La gente de Gaza ha pecado una y otra vez, \q así que no retendré su castigo. \q Capturaron poblaciones enteras y las entregaron como esclavos a Edom.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Pour trois transgressions de Gaza, \q et pour quatre, je ne le retirerai pas, \q parce qu’ils ont déporté une population entière, pour [la] livrer à Édom.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Pour trois crimes de Gaza, \q et même pour quatre, je ne retiendrai pas le châtiment, \q parce qu’ils ont déporté des populations entières et les ont livrées à Édom.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Les gens de Gaza ont péché encore et encore, \q alors je ne retiendrai pas leur punition. \q Ils ont capturé des populations entières et les ont livrées comme esclaves à Édom.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Kwa maasi matatu ya Gaza, \q naam, kwa manne, sitalirudisha nyuma, \q kwa sababu waliwachukua uhamishoni jamii nzima, ili [kuwatia] mikononi mwa Edomu.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Kwa makosa matatu ya Gaza, \q hata kwa manne, sitaizuia adhabu, \q kwa sababu waliwachukua uhamishoni jamii nzima nzima na kuwatia mikononi mwa Edomu.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Watu wa Gaza wamefanya dhambi tena na tena, \q kwa hiyo sitaizuia adhabu yao. \q Waliteka jamii nzima nzima na kuwapeleka kwa Edomu kuwa watumwa.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Vì ba tội vi phạm của Ga-xa, \q và vì bốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại điều ấy, \q vì chúng đã bắt đi lưu đày trọn cả một cộng đồng, để nộp [họ] cho Ê-đôm.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Vì ba tội ác của Ga-xa, \q phải, vì bốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại hình phạt, \q vì chúng đã bắt trọn những cộng đồng đi lưu đày và nộp họ cho Ê-đôm.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Dân Ga-xa đã phạm tội hết lần này đến lần khác, \q nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại hình phạt dành cho chúng. \q Chúng đã bắt trọn những cộng đồng dân cư và nộp họ cho Ê-đôm làm nô lệ.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 가사의 세 가지 반역과 \q 네 가지 [반역] 때문에 내가 그것을 되돌리지 않겠다. \q 그들이 온 공동체를 사로잡아 에돔에 넘겨주었기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 가사가 지은 범죄가 셋, \q 아니 넷이나 되니 내가 그 벌을 거두지 않겠다. \q 그들이 마을 사람들을 모조리 사로잡아 에돔에 넘겨주었기 때문이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 가사 백성이 죄를 짓고 또 지었으니 \q 나는 그들에게 내릴 벌을 거두지 않겠다. \q 그들은 마을 사람들을 모두 사로잡아 에돔에 노예로 넘겨주었다.

decisions.choice: the refrain "for three transgressions ... and for four", as in 1:3
decisions.reason: The oracle opens with the same refrain as the others. On the number pattern and on the unnamed "it" in "I will not turn it back", see the notes at 1:3.

decisions.choice: Gaza: the southernmost of the Philistine cities, on the coast road to Egypt
decisions.reason: Gaza, with Ashdod, Ashkelon and Ekron (verse 8), was one of the five Philistine cities on the southern coast (Joshua 13:3; 1 Samuel 6:17). Gaza stood on the trade route between Egypt and the north.

decisions.choice: carried into exile a whole community ... to hand them over to Edom: the slave trade
decisions.reason: "A complete exile" means a whole population taken, leaving no one behind. The people were seized in raids, not taken in a war of defense, and sold on to Edom, a trading people on the routes south and east. Whose people they were is not said; Philistine raids on Judah are recorded in 2 Chronicles 21:16-17 and 28:18. Tyre is charged with the same trade in 1:9, and Joel 4:4-6 accuses Tyre, Sidon and Philistia of selling the people of Judah.

decisions.choice: handed them over to Edom as slaves
decisions.reason: Readable adds "as slaves" to make clear why whole communities were handed over (m3).

source.text: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּחוֹמַ֣ת עַזָּ֑ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

en.R: So I will send fire on the walls of Gaza, \q and it will burn up its fortresses.

es.B: Por eso enviaré fuego sobre el muro de Gaza, \q y devorará sus fortalezas.
es.R: Por eso enviaré fuego sobre las murallas de Gaza, \q y quemará sus fortalezas.

fr.B: Alors j’enverrai le feu sur la muraille de Gaza, \q et il dévorera ses forteresses.

sw.B: Basi nitatuma moto juu ya ukuta wa Gaza, \q nao utazila ngome zake.

vi.L: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai lửa xuống trên tường thành Ga-xa, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu nuốt các đồn lũy của nó.
vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai lửa xuống trên tường thành Ga-xa, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu rụi các đồn lũy của nó.
vi.R: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai lửa xuống trên các tường thành Ga-xa, \q và lửa sẽ đốt cháy các đồn lũy của nó.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 가사의 성벽에 불을 보내겠다. \q 그 불이 그 요새들을 사를 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 가사의 성벽에 불을 보내겠다. \q 그 불이 그 요새들을 삼킬 것이다.
ko.R: 그러므로 나는 가사의 성벽에 불을 보내겠다. \q 그 불이 그 요새들을 태워 버릴 것이다.

decisions.choice: send fire ... consume its fortresses: the punishment repeated in every oracle
decisions.reason: The same words as 1:4, with Gaza's wall in place of Hazael's house. Fire on the wall pictures the city taken and burned by an enemy.

source.text: וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ מֵֽאַשְׁדּ֔וֹד וְתוֹמֵ֥ךְ שֵׁ֖בֶט מֵֽאַשְׁקְל֑וֹן וַהֲשִׁיב֨וֹתִי יָדִ֜י עַל־עֶקְר֗וֹן וְאָֽבְדוּ֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I will cut off [the] one sitting from Ashdod, and [the] one holding [the] scepter from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron, and will perish [the] remnant of [the] Philistines, says [the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: And I will cut off the one who sits from Ashdod, \q and the one holding the scepter from Ashkelon; \q and I will turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand upon Ekron, and the Philistines' remnant will perish, \q says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will cut off the ruler from Ashdod \q and the one who holds the scepter from Ashkelon. \q I will turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against Ekron, and the last of the Philistines will perish, \q says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will remove the king who rules in Ashdod \q and the one who holds the scepter in Ashkelon. \q I will turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} power against Ekron, and every last Philistine will die, \q says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y cortaré al que se sienta [en el trono] en Asdod, \q y al que empuña el cetro en Ascalón; \q y volveré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra Ecrón, y perecerá el resto de los filisteos, \q dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Eliminaré al gobernante de Asdod \q y al que empuña el cetro en Ascalón. \q Volveré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra Ecrón, y perecerán los últimos filisteos, \q dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Quitaré al rey que gobierna en Asdod \q y al que tiene el cetro en Ascalón. \q Volveré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder contra Ecrón, y morirán hasta los últimos filisteos, \q dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et je retrancherai d’Ashdod celui qui siège, \q et d’Ashqelôn celui qui tient le sceptre ; \q et je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre Eqrôn, et le reste des Philistins périra, \q dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je retrancherai d’Ashdod celui qui règne \q et d’Ashqelôn celui qui tient le sceptre. \q Je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre Eqrôn, et les derniers Philistins périront, \q dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je ferai disparaître le roi qui règne à Ashdod \q et celui qui tient le sceptre à Ashqelôn. \q Je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance contre Eqrôn, et les Philistins mourront jusqu’au dernier, \q dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitamkatilia mbali yule aketiye kutoka Ashdodi, \q na yule ashikaye fimbo ya enzi kutoka Ashkeloni; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaugeuza mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu ya Ekroni, na mabaki ya Wafilisti yataangamia, \q asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitamkatilia mbali mtawala kutoka Ashdodi \q na yule ashikaye fimbo ya enzi kutoka Ashkeloni. \q Nitaugeuza mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi ya Ekroni, na Wafilisti waliobaki wataangamia, \q asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitamwondoa mfalme anayetawala katika Ashdodi \q na yule ashikaye fimbo ya enzi katika Ashkeloni. \q Nitaigeuza nguvu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} dhidi ya Ekroni, na Mfilisti wa mwisho kabisa atakufa, \q anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ diệt trừ kẻ ngồi [trên ngai] khỏi Ách-đốt, \q và kẻ cầm quyền trượng khỏi Ách-ca-lôn; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trở tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nghịch cùng Éc-rôn, và những người Phi-li-tin sót lại sẽ bị diệt vong, \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.B: Ta sẽ diệt trừ kẻ cai trị khỏi Ách-đốt \q và kẻ cầm quyền trượng khỏi Ách-ca-lôn. \q Ta sẽ trở tay đánh Éc-rôn, và những người Phi-li-tin cuối cùng sẽ bị diệt vong, \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.R: Ta sẽ loại bỏ vua cai trị ở Ách-đốt \q và kẻ cầm quyền trượng ở Ách-ca-lôn. \q Ta sẽ dùng quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đánh Éc-rôn, và mọi người Phi-li-tin còn sót lại đều sẽ chết, \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 내가 아스돗에서 앉은 자를 끊어 버리고, \q 아스글론에서 홀을 잡은 자를 [끊어 버리겠다]. \q 내 손을 돌려 에그론을 치겠으니, 블레셋의 남은 자가 멸망할 것이다. \q 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.
ko.B: 내가 아스돗에서 통치자를 없애고, \q 아스글론에서 홀을 잡은 자를 없애겠다. \q 내 손을 돌려 에그론을 치겠으니, 블레셋 사람들은 마지막 하나까지 멸망할 것이다. \q 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.
ko.R: 나는 아스돗을 다스리는 왕을 없애고, \q 아스글론에서 홀을 잡은 자도 없애겠다. \q 내 힘으로 에그론을 치겠다. 블레셋 사람은 마지막 한 사람까지 죽을 것이다. \q 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.

decisions.choice: the one who sits: the ruler, as in verse 5
decisions.reason: As in verse 5, "the one who sits" stands beside "the one who holds the scepter" and most likely means the ruler.

decisions.choice: Ashdod, Ashkelon and Ekron, with Gaza: four of the five Philistine cities; Gath is not named
decisions.reason: The five cities of the Philistines were Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron (1 Samuel 6:17). Gath is missing here. In 6:2 Amos points to Gath as a city that has already fallen, and 2 Chronicles 26:6 says that Uzziah broke down its wall, so it may already have been ruined or under another power. The text does not explain the omission.

decisions.choice: turn my hand against: strike
decisions.reason: The LORD's hand is his power. To turn it against a place is to strike it (Isaiah 1:25; Psalm 81:15).

decisions.choice: the remnant of the Philistines will perish: every last one of them
decisions.reason: "Remnant" here means whatever is left after the cities fall. Not even the survivors will survive.

decisions.choice: says the Lord GOD (L, B, R); my power (R)
decisions.reason: The divine title here is the Lord with the divine name, written "the Lord GOD" as in the other prophets. Readable says "power" for "hand" (m3).

source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵי־צֹ֔ר וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַֽל־הַסְגִּירָ֞ם גָּל֤וּת שְׁלֵמָה֙ לֶאֱד֔וֹם וְלֹ֥א זָכְר֖וּ בְּרִ֥ית אַחִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: For three transgressions of Tyre and for four, not I will turn it back, because they delivered up a complete exile to Edom, and not they remembered [the] covenant of brothers.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q For three transgressions of Tyre, \q and for four, I will not turn it back, \q because they handed over a whole community of exiles to Edom \q and did not remember the covenant of brothers.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q For three crimes of Tyre, \q even for four, I will not hold back the punishment, \q because they handed over whole communities of captives to Edom \q and did not remember the treaty of brotherhood.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q The people of Tyre have sinned again and again, \q so I will not hold back their punishment. \q They handed over whole communities of captives to Edom \q and ignored the treaty that made them like brothers.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Por tres transgresiones de Tiro, \q y por cuatro, no lo haré volver atrás, \q porque entregaron a Edom a toda una población de cautivos \q y no se acordaron del pacto de hermanos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q Por tres delitos de Tiro, \q y aun por cuatro, no retendré el castigo, \q porque entregaron a Edom poblaciones enteras de cautivos \q y no se acordaron del tratado de hermandad.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q La gente de Tiro ha pecado una y otra vez, \q así que no retendré su castigo. \q Entregaron a Edom poblaciones enteras de prisioneros \q y no hicieron caso del tratado que los había hecho como hermanos.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Pour trois transgressions de Tyr, \q et pour quatre, je ne le retirerai pas, \q parce qu’ils ont livré à Édom une population entière d’exilés, \q et ne se sont pas souvenus de l’alliance de frères.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Pour trois crimes de Tyr, \q et même pour quatre, je ne retiendrai pas le châtiment, \q parce qu’ils ont livré à Édom des populations entières de captifs \q et ne se sont pas souvenus du traité de fraternité.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Les gens de Tyr ont péché encore et encore, \q alors je ne retiendrai pas leur punition. \q Ils ont livré à Édom des populations entières de captifs, \q et ils n’ont pas respecté le traité qui faisait d’eux des frères.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Kwa maasi matatu ya Tiro, \q naam, kwa manne, sitalirudisha nyuma, \q kwa sababu waliitia mikononi mwa Edomu jamii nzima ya watu wa uhamishoni, \q wala hawakulikumbuka agano la ndugu.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Kwa makosa matatu ya Tiro, \q hata kwa manne, sitaizuia adhabu, \q kwa sababu waliwatia mikononi mwa Edomu jamii nzima nzima za mateka, \q wala hawakuukumbuka mkataba wa udugu.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Watu wa Tiro wamefanya dhambi tena na tena, \q kwa hiyo sitaizuia adhabu yao. \q Waliwatia mikononi mwa Edomu jamii nzima nzima za mateka, \q wakaupuuza mkataba uliowafanya kuwa kama ndugu.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Vì ba tội vi phạm của Ty-rơ, \q và vì bốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại điều ấy, \q vì chúng đã nộp trọn cả một cộng đồng phu tù cho Ê-đôm \q và không nhớ đến giao ước anh em.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Vì ba tội ác của Ty-rơ, \q phải, vì bốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại hình phạt, \q vì chúng đã nộp trọn những cộng đồng phu tù cho Ê-đôm \q và không nhớ đến hiệp ước anh em.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Dân Ty-rơ đã phạm tội hết lần này đến lần khác, \q nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại hình phạt dành cho chúng. \q Chúng đã nộp trọn những cộng đồng phu tù cho Ê-đôm \q và không đếm xỉa đến hiệp ước đã khiến họ như anh em.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 두로의 세 가지 반역과 \q 네 가지 [반역] 때문에 내가 그것을 되돌리지 않겠다. \q 그들이 사로잡은 온 공동체를 에돔에 넘겨주고, \q 형제의 언약을 기억하지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 두로가 지은 범죄가 셋, \q 아니 넷이나 되니 내가 그 벌을 거두지 않겠다. \q 그들이 사로잡은 마을 사람들을 모조리 에돔에 넘겨주고, \q 형제의 조약을 기억하지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 두로 백성이 죄를 짓고 또 지었으니 \q 나는 그들에게 내릴 벌을 거두지 않겠다. \q 그들은 사로잡은 마을 사람들을 모두 에돔에 넘겨주었다. \q 형제처럼 지내자고 맺은 조약을 무시했다.

decisions.choice: the refrain "for three transgressions ... and for four", as in 1:3
decisions.reason: The oracle opens with the same refrain as the others. On the number pattern and on the unnamed "it" in "I will not turn it back", see the notes at 1:3.

decisions.choice: Tyre: the great Phoenician port, here as a dealer in captives
decisions.reason: Tyre was the chief trading city of the Phoenician coast, north of Israel (Ezekiel 27). Ezekiel 27:13 lists people among the goods it traded, and Joel 4:4-6 accuses Tyre and Sidon of selling the people of Judah. The charge is the same as Gaza's (verse 6), but Tyre is said to have handed captives over, not to have taken them: it was the trader.

decisions.choice: the covenant of brothers: a treaty between allies, who called each other "brother"
decisions.reason: Kings bound by treaty called each other "brother": Hiram king of Tyre calls Solomon "my brother" (1 Kings 9:13), and the two made a treaty (1 Kings 5:26). Ahab of Israel married Jezebel, daughter of the king of Sidon (1 Kings 16:31). So the broken covenant was most likely a treaty with Israel, but the text does not name the other party.

decisions.choice: covenant (L), treaty (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the one used for God's covenant, but here it is a pact between nations, which English calls a treaty.

decisions.choice: "giao ước anh em" (L); "hiệp ước anh em" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English covenant / treaty: the word is a treaty between allies who called each other "brother" (meaning decision), so Balanced and Readable say "hiệp ước".

en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q The people of Edom have sinned again and again, \q so I will not hold back their punishment. \q They hunted down their brother nation, Israel, with swords and showed no pity. \q Their anger kept tearing like a wild animal, \q and they never let go of their fury.

fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Les gens d’Édom ont péché encore et encore, \q alors je ne retiendrai pas leur punition. \q Ils ont pourchassé avec l’épée la nation de leur frère, Israël, et ils ont été sans pitié. \q Leur colère ne cessait de déchirer comme une bête sauvage, \q et ils ne se sont jamais défaits de leur fureur.

decisions.choice: the refrain "for three transgressions ... and for four", as in 1:3
decisions.reason: The oracle opens with the same refrain as the others. On the number pattern and on the unnamed "it" in "I will not turn it back", see the notes at 1:3.

decisions.choice: his brother: Israel, for Edom descended from Esau, Jacob's brother
decisions.reason: Edom's ancestor was Esau, the twin brother of Jacob, who is Israel (Genesis 25:23-30; 36:1). The Old Testament keeps calling Israel Edom's brother (Numbers 20:14; Deuteronomy 23:8; Obadiah 10-12), and Edom's hostility to Israel and Judah runs through its history (2 Kings 8:20-22; Psalm 137:7). "Brother" could also mean a treaty partner, as in verse 9, but the family sense fits Edom best.

decisions.choice: destroyed his compassion: smothered the pity he should have felt
decisions.reason: The word for compassion is related to the word for womb, the tender feeling of family. Edom, of all peoples, should have felt it for his brother, and he killed it. Some read the word as "his allies" or "his women", so that Edom destroyed people rather than a feeling, but the sense "compassion" is its usual one.

decisions.choice: his anger tore continually, and he kept his fury forever: Edom's anger was like a beast that kept tearing its prey
alternatives: he kept his anger continually (Syriac, Latin)
decisions.reason: "Tore" is the verb for a wild animal tearing its prey (Genesis 37:33; Job 16:9), so Edom's anger is pictured as a beast that never stops. The Syriac and Latin translations read "he kept his anger" instead, with a verb that differs from "tore" by one letter, matching "kept his fury" in the next line. In the last line the Hebrew form of "kept" is unusual and could also mean "his fury kept watch". The Hebrew as it stands makes good sense, and it is followed here.

decisions.choice: stifled all compassion (B); their brother nation, Israel; like a wild animal (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names the brother as Israel (m2) and says "like a wild animal" to explain "tore" (m4). It speaks of Edom as "they", where the Hebrew uses "he" for the nation.

decisions.choice: "nó" for Edom (L, B); "chúng" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of Edom as one man, "he"; Vietnamese uses "nó" for a nation, as the terms sheet says, and Readable turns to the people, "chúng".

source.text: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּתֵימָ֑ן וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בָּצְרָֽה׃פ

en.B: So I will send fire on Teman, \q and it will devour the fortresses of Bozrah.
en.R: So I will send fire on the land of Teman, \q and it will burn up the fortresses of Bozrah.

es.B: Por eso enviaré fuego sobre Temán, \q y devorará las fortalezas de Bosra.
es.R: Por eso enviaré fuego sobre la tierra de Temán, \q y quemará las fortalezas de Bosra.

fr.B: Alors j’enverrai le feu sur Téman, \q et il dévorera les forteresses de Bosra.
fr.R: Alors j’enverrai le feu sur le pays de Téman, \q et il brûlera les forteresses de Bosra.

sw.L: Basi nitatuma moto juu ya Temani, \q nao utaziteketeza ngome za Bozra.
sw.B: Basi nitatuma moto juu ya Temani, \q nao utazila ngome za Bozra.
sw.R: Basi nitatuma moto juu ya nchi ya Temani, \q nao utaziunguza ngome za Bozra.

vi.L: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai lửa xuống trên Thê-man, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu nuốt các đồn lũy của Bốt-ra.
vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai lửa xuống trên Thê-man, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu rụi các đồn lũy của Bốt-ra.
vi.R: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai lửa xuống trên xứ Thê-man, \q và lửa sẽ đốt cháy các đồn lũy của Bốt-ra.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 데만에 불을 보내겠다. \q 그 불이 보스라의 요새들을 사를 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 데만에 불을 보내겠다. \q 그 불이 보스라의 요새들을 삼킬 것이다.
ko.R: 그러므로 나는 데만 땅에 불을 보내겠다. \q 그 불이 보스라의 요새들을 태워 버릴 것이다.

decisions.choice: Teman and Bozrah: a region and a chief city of Edom, standing for the whole land
decisions.reason: Teman is a district of Edom, its name used for Edom itself in poetry (Jeremiah 49:7, 20; Obadiah 9). Bozrah was one of Edom's chief cities (Isaiah 34:6; 63:1; Jeremiah 49:13), south-east of the Dead Sea. Fire on both means fire on all of Edom. The punishment is the same as in 1:4.

decisions.choice: the land of Teman
decisions.reason: Readable adds "the land of" so that Teman is understood as a region.

source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־עַמּ֔וֹן וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־בִּקְעָם֙ הָר֣וֹת הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לְמַ֖עַן הַרְחִ֥יב אֶת־גְּבוּלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: For three transgressions of [the] sons of Ammon and for four, not I will turn it back, because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead, in order to enlarge their border.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q For three transgressions of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon, \q and for four, I will not turn it back, \q because they tore open the pregnant women of Gilead \q in order to enlarge their border.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q For three crimes of the Ammonites, \q even for four, I will not hold back the punishment, \q because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead \q to enlarge their own territory.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q The people of Ammon have sinned again and again, \q so I will not hold back their punishment. \q They cut open the pregnant women of Gilead \q just to make their own land bigger.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Por tres transgresiones de los hijos de Amón, \q y por cuatro, no lo haré volver atrás, \q porque abrieron en canal a las mujeres embarazadas de Galaad \q para ensanchar su territorio.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q Por tres delitos de los amonitas, \q y aun por cuatro, no retendré el castigo, \q porque abrieron el vientre a las mujeres embarazadas de Galaad \q para agrandar su propio territorio.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q La gente de Amón ha pecado una y otra vez, \q así que no retendré su castigo. \q Abrieron el vientre a las mujeres embarazadas de Galaad \q solo para hacer más grande su propia tierra.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Pour trois transgressions des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon, \q et pour quatre, je ne le retirerai pas, \q parce qu’ils ont éventré les femmes enceintes de Galaad \q afin d’agrandir leur territoire.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Pour trois crimes des Ammonites, \q et même pour quatre, je ne retiendrai pas le châtiment, \q parce qu’ils ont éventré les femmes enceintes de Galaad \q pour agrandir leur propre territoire.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Les gens d’Ammon ont péché encore et encore, \q alors je ne retiendrai pas leur punition. \q Ils ont ouvert le ventre des femmes enceintes de Galaad \q seulement pour agrandir leur pays.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Kwa maasi matatu ya wana wa Amoni, \q naam, kwa manne, sitalirudisha nyuma, \q kwa sababu waliwatumbua wanawake wenye mimba wa Gileadi \q ili kuupanua mpaka wao.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Kwa makosa matatu ya Waamoni, \q hata kwa manne, sitaizuia adhabu, \q kwa sababu waliwatumbua wanawake wenye mimba wa Gileadi \q ili kuipanua nchi yao wenyewe.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Watu wa Amoni wamefanya dhambi tena na tena, \q kwa hiyo sitaizuia adhabu yao. \q Waliwatumbua wanawake wenye mimba wa Gileadi \q ili tu kuifanya nchi yao kuwa kubwa zaidi.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Vì ba tội vi phạm của con cái Am-môn, \q và vì bốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại điều ấy, \q vì chúng đã mổ bụng những phụ nữ có thai ở Ga-la-át \q để mở rộng bờ cõi của chúng.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Vì ba tội ác của người Am-môn, \q phải, vì bốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại hình phạt, \q vì chúng đã mổ bụng những phụ nữ có thai ở Ga-la-át \q để mở rộng lãnh thổ của mình.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Dân Am-môn đã phạm tội hết lần này đến lần khác, \q nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại hình phạt dành cho chúng. \q Chúng đã mổ bụng các phụ nữ có thai ở Ga-la-át \q chỉ để làm cho đất đai mình rộng thêm.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q {{gender:암몬 자손|암몬의 아들들}}의 세 가지 반역과 \q 네 가지 [반역] 때문에 내가 그것을 되돌리지 않겠다. \q 그들이 자기들의 경계를 넓히려고 \q 길르앗의 아이 밴 여자들의 배를 갈랐기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 암몬 사람들이 지은 범죄가 셋, \q 아니 넷이나 되니 내가 그 벌을 거두지 않겠다. \q 그들이 자기 영토를 넓히려고 \q 길르앗의 임신한 여자들의 배를 갈랐기 때문이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 암몬 백성이 죄를 짓고 또 지었으니 \q 나는 그들에게 내릴 벌을 거두지 않겠다. \q 그들은 길르앗의 임신한 여자들의 배를 갈랐다. \q 자기 땅을 넓히려고 그런 짓을 했다.

decisions.choice: the refrain "for three transgressions ... and for four", as in 1:3
decisions.reason: The oracle opens with the same refrain as the others. On the number pattern and on the unnamed "it" in "I will not turn it back", see the notes at 1:3.

decisions.choice: the sons of Ammon: the Ammonites, a people east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: "The sons of Ammon" is the usual name for the people of Ammon, whose land lay east of the Jordan, around their capital Rabbah (verse 14), the modern Amman. They traced their descent to Lot (Genesis 19:38).

decisions.choice: ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead: a war atrocity, to wipe out the next generation and seize the land
decisions.reason: Ripping open pregnant women was one of the horrors of ancient warfare (2 Kings 8:12; 15:16; Hosea 14:1). It killed the coming generation of the conquered people. Gilead, Israel's land east of the Jordan, bordered Ammon, and the Ammonites did this not in self-defense but to take more land.

decisions.choice: the children (sons) of Ammon (L), the Ammonites (B), the people of Ammon (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew name for the people, with the gender setting, since the people are men and women. Balanced uses the English name of the people. Readable says "the people of Ammon", as it says "the people of X" in every oracle of the refrain.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Amón", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" already includes the whole people, so no gender span stands where the English has one, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "wana wa Amoni" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Wana" already covers sons and daughters, so the English gender alternative (children / sons) has nothing to change in Swahili; this holds wherever the English has a gender span in these books.

decisions.choice: "con cái Am-môn" (L), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "sons" as a gender setting; Vietnamese "con cái" already covers both and is the plain way to name a people by its ancestor, so no span is needed.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:암몬 자손|암몬의 아들들}}" (L)
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span here; Korean has the same two wordings, the inclusive "자손" and the literal "아들들", as Isaiah 66:20 does.

source.text: וְהִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּחוֹמַ֣ת רַבָּ֔ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ בִּתְרוּעָה֙ בְּי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּסַ֖עַר בְּי֥וֹם סוּפָֽה

records.literal_gloss: And I will kindle fire on [the] wall of Rabbah, and it will consume its fortresses, with a shout on [the] day of battle, with a storm on [the] day of [the] whirlwind.

en.L: So I will kindle fire on the wall of Rabbah, \q and it will consume its fortresses, \q with a war cry on the day of battle, \q with a storm on the day of the whirlwind.
en.B: So I will set fire to the wall of Rabbah, \q and it will devour its fortresses \q amid war cries on the day of battle, \q amid a storm on the day of the whirlwind.
en.R: So I will set fire to the walls of Rabbah, \q and it will burn up its fortresses. \q Soldiers will shout as the battle begins, \q and the attack will strike like a whirlwind in a storm.

es.L: Por eso encenderé fuego en el muro de Rabá, \q y consumirá sus fortalezas, \q con gritos de guerra en el día de la batalla, \q con tempestad en el día del torbellino.
es.B: Por eso prenderé fuego al muro de Rabá, \q y devorará sus fortalezas \q entre gritos de guerra en el día de la batalla, \q entre la tempestad en el día del torbellino.
es.R: Por eso prenderé fuego a las murallas de Rabá, \q y quemará sus fortalezas. \q Los soldados gritarán al comenzar la batalla, \q y el ataque llegará como un torbellino en medio de una tormenta.

fr.L: Alors j’allumerai le feu sur la muraille de Rabba, \q et il consumera ses forteresses, \q avec des cris de guerre au jour de la bataille, \q avec une tempête au jour de l’ouragan.
fr.B: Alors je mettrai le feu à la muraille de Rabba, \q et il dévorera ses forteresses \q au milieu des cris de guerre, au jour de la bataille, \q au milieu de la tempête, au jour de l’ouragan.
fr.R: Alors je mettrai le feu aux murailles de Rabba, \q et il brûlera ses forteresses. \q Les soldats crieront quand la bataille commencera, \q et l’attaque frappera comme un ouragan dans la tempête.

sw.L: Basi nitawasha moto juu ya ukuta wa Raba, \q nao utaziteketeza ngome zake, \q pamoja na kelele za vita siku ya mapigano, \q pamoja na dhoruba siku ya kisulisuli.
sw.B: Basi nitaunguza ukuta wa Raba kwa moto, \q nao utazila ngome zake \q katikati ya makelele ya vita siku ya mapigano, \q katikati ya dhoruba siku ya kisulisuli.
sw.R: Basi nitazichoma moto kuta za Raba, \q nao utaziunguza ngome zake. \q Askari watapiga kelele vita vinapoanza, \q na shambulio litapiga kama kisulisuli katika dhoruba.

vi.L: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm lửa trên tường thành Ráp-ba, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu nuốt các đồn lũy của nó, \q giữa tiếng hò hét trong ngày chiến trận, \q giữa cơn bão trong ngày gió lốc.
vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ châm lửa đốt tường thành Ráp-ba, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu rụi các đồn lũy của nó \q giữa tiếng hò hét xung trận trong ngày giao chiến, \q giữa cơn bão tố trong ngày gió lốc.
vi.R: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phóng hỏa các tường thành Ráp-ba, \q và lửa sẽ đốt cháy các đồn lũy của nó. \q Binh lính sẽ hò hét khi trận chiến bắt đầu, \q và cuộc tấn công sẽ ập đến như cơn lốc giữa bão tố.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 랍바의 성벽에 불을 붙이겠다. \q 그 불이 그 요새들을 사를 것이다. \q 전쟁의 날에 함성이 [울리고], \q 회오리바람의 날에 폭풍이 [몰아칠 것이다].
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 랍바의 성벽에 불을 놓겠다. \q 그 불이 그 요새들을 삼킬 것이다. \q 전쟁의 날에 함성이 울려 퍼지고, \q 회오리바람이 부는 날에 폭풍이 몰아칠 것이다.
ko.R: 그러므로 나는 랍바의 성벽에 불을 놓겠다. \q 그 불이 그 요새들을 태워 버릴 것이다. \q 전쟁이 시작되면 군인들이 함성을 지를 것이다. \q 적군은 폭풍 속의 회오리바람처럼 들이닥칠 것이다.

decisions.choice: Rabbah: the capital of Ammon; "kindle" in place of "send"
decisions.reason: Rabbah was the royal city of the Ammonites (2 Samuel 12:26-31), the modern Amman. The verb "kindle" replaces "send" of the other oracles, but the punishment is the same: fire on the wall and its fortresses (1:4).

decisions.choice: a war cry on the day of battle: the shout of the attacking army
decisions.reason: The word is the loud shout raised as an army charges (Joshua 6:5, 20; Jeremiah 4:19; 49:2, where it is also raised against Rabbah).

decisions.choice: a storm on the day of the whirlwind: the attack comes with the force of a storm
decisions.reason: The storm pictures the speed and violence of the attack (Isaiah 28:2; Jeremiah 23:19). The LORD himself is often pictured as coming in storm and whirlwind (Nahum 1:3; Isaiah 29:6), so the line also hints at whose attack it is.

decisions.choice: set fire to (B, R); Soldiers will shout as the battle begins; the attack will strike like a whirlwind (R)
decisions.reason: Readable turns the two phrases into sentences and says who shouts and what the storm stands for (m2, m3).

source.text: וְהָלַ֥ךְ מַלְכָּ֖ם בַּגּוֹלָ֑ה ה֧וּא וְשָׂרָ֛יו יַחְדָּ֖ו אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And will go their king into exile, he and his officials together, says Yahweh.

en.L: And their king will go into exile, \q he and his officials together, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Their king will go into exile, \q he and his officials together, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Their king will be taken away as a captive, \q together with his leaders, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y su rey irá al cautiverio, \q él y sus príncipes juntamente, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Su rey irá al destierro, \q él y sus jefes juntos, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Su rey será llevado prisionero \q junto con sus dirigentes, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et leur roi ira en exil, \q lui et ses chefs ensemble, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Leur roi ira en exil, \q lui et ses chefs avec lui, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Leur roi sera emmené en captivité \q avec ses dirigeants, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na mfalme wao atakwenda uhamishoni, \q yeye na maafisa wake pamoja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mfalme wao atakwenda uhamishoni, \q yeye na maafisa wake pamoja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mfalme wao atachukuliwa mateka, \q pamoja na viongozi wake, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và vua của chúng sẽ đi lưu đày, \q vua cùng các quan chức của vua, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.B: Vua của chúng sẽ bị lưu đày, \q vua cùng các quan chức của mình, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.R: Vua của chúng sẽ bị bắt đi làm phu tù, \q cùng với các người lãnh đạo của vua, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 그들의 왕이 사로잡혀 갈 것이다. \q 그와 그의 고관들이 함께 [갈 것이다]. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.B: 그들의 왕이 사로잡혀 가고, \q 그의 관리들도 함께 끌려갈 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 그들의 왕이 포로가 되어 끌려갈 것이다. \q 그의 지도자들도 함께 끌려갈 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: their king: the king of Ammon
alternatives: Milcom, the god of the Ammonites
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew letters, read with other vowels, give Milcom, the name of the god of the Ammonites (1 Kings 11:5, 33). Jeremiah 49:3, which echoes this verse, says "Milcom will go into exile, with his priests and his officials", and some ancient translations read the god's name here. In Amos the parallel with "his officials" and the pattern of the other oracles (1:5, 8; 2:3) favor the king.

decisions.choice: his officials: the king's chief men, who governed under him
decisions.reason: The word names the princes, commanders and ministers of a court. King and court go into exile together, so the nation is left without rulers.

decisions.choice: officials (L, B), leaders (R); taken away as a captive (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this word is "officials" at Literal and Balanced and "leaders" at Readable. Readable says what going into exile means.

decisions.choice: "príncipes" (L), "jefes" (B), "dirigentes" (R)
decisions.reason: Sarim of human officials as the Spanish of Jeremiah has them, which the terms note keeps for the Twelve against the English "officials".

decisions.choice: "ses chefs" (L, B); "ses dirigeants" (R) for the king's officials (sarim), in the whole book
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for sarim in the Twelve: "princes" would make them the king's sons in modern French.

decisions.choice: "các quan chức" (L, B); "các người lãnh đạo" (R)
